title: Inasmuch as: в той мере, в какой
description: Inasmuch as: в той мере, в какой: словарь, грамматическая модель и авторский текст с разбором смысла и объяснениями ответов.
notes: В данном уроке inasmuch as означает to the extent that — в той мере, в какой.
У конструкции бывают причинные употребления; значение выбирается по полному контексту.

quality.method: author-review + schema/grader/editorial-reference checks; no independent teacher review

exercises.prompt: Выбери точный вариант: In the explicit “to the extent that” sense, inasmuch as limits the ___ of a claim.
exercises.explanation: В заданном значении конструкция ограничивает область утверждения.

exercises.prompt: Вставь слово из пары: than / that.

public_payload.sentence: The review is useful to the extent ___ it covers our needs.

exercises.editorial_answer: The review is useful to the extent that it covers our needs.
exercises.explanation: Устойчивая форма — to the extent that.

exercises.prompt: Собери предложение: «Отчёт полезен в той мере, в какой отвечает на наш вопрос.»

exercises.incorrect_answer: The report is useful to the extent than it addresses the question.
exercises.editorial_answer: The report is useful to the extent that it addresses the question.

public_payload.passage: The panel described a report as useful inasmuch as it addressed the narrow question under review. The surrounding paragraph explicitly defined the phrase as meaning to the extent that, then listed several wider questions the report did not consider. A summary removed the qualification and called it a comprehensive assessment. The panel objected: usefulness for a specified purpose did not establish comprehensive coverage. Its correction did not deny that the report helped with the original question. It restored the limited basis of that positive judgement and kept the unexamined questions visible for future work rather than treating them as already settled.

options.label: As a claim of complete coverage.
As a denial of any usefulness.
